# ecotrajpy

> Clean-room Python port of Ecological Trajectory Analysis (ETA). ecotraj 1.2.2 is the test oracle.

Provenance: written by AI coding agents from the published papers; an independent implementation (no ecotraj source copied or translated), benchmarked against the R package ecotraj run as a separate program. See NOTICE.

This file points coding agents at the canonical docs. Start with AGENTS.md.

## Start here

- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): purpose, repo map, setup, invariants, commands
- [README.md](README.md): what it is, install from source, quickstart, R mapping, parity, citations

## Package

- [docs/api.md](docs/api.md): API reference

- [docs/PARITY.md](docs/PARITY.md): 1,260/1,280 parity and the 20 R floating-point quirks
- [src/ecotrajpy/](src/ecotrajpy/): package source
